channel.title: Changelog :: Unreal Metadata Editor Tags Documentation
channel.description: 1.1.0 Applying changes to multiple assets at once is now smarter and will not accidentally overwrite metadatatags. Overwrite and Append are now replaced by Clear & Overwrite and Smart Apply. Clear & Overwrite All assets end up having exactly the same properties as visible in Metadata Tags Editor. *Smart Apply * This feature compares initial metadata tags with what is visible in the editor. The editor knows which tags were added, removed, modified or left unchanged.
